scope: native static crop candidates; not full-game, animation, navigation or client acceptance
nearZeroAlphaPolicy: Preserve source values. Alpha=1 background quantization residue may meet a crop edge; no source alpha>1 content touches an edge.
anchorMethod: bottom center of alpha>1 content bbox; provisional, no collider contract
sourceReceiptEvidenceGaps: v2 native images were recovered; original complete tool response and precise call completion time are unavailable. See unchanged generation records.
